policy.summary_rule: A summary may locate an experiment or preserve a secondary number, but it is never promoted to an original metric-bearing artifact.
policy.missing_rule: When the original run output, attempt ledger, manifest copy, or terminal report is absent, the field is explicitly marked missing; no numerator, seed, process independence, or causal explanation is reconstructed from prose.
policy.denominator_rule: All-attempt denominators are primary when serialized. Hull-known and reconstructed denominators are reported only when the artifact labels them explicitly. Unknown hull values are missing, never silently unstable.
policy.git_object_rule: git:<ref>@<commit>:<path> denotes an immutable blob readable from the local Git object database but not checked out in this worktree.
